content.text: The text first provides an extensive medical index covering thirst, tongue and tonsil diseases, treatments, intestinal disorders, urinary findings, and related conditions. It then narrates Civil War campaigns: Lee’s victory at Chancellorsville, Jackson’s wounding, Grant’s capture of Vicksburg and Port Hudson, Gettysburg, Chickamauga, Chattanooga, the Wilderness, Spotsylvania, Cold Harbor, and Sherman’s advance toward Atlanta. Major themes include costly assaults, strategic flanking, sieges, artillery, endurance, and eventual Union dominance. Hooker withdrew to Falmouth; Sedgwick retreated across the Rappahannock; Grant advanced from Grand Gulf through Jackson toward Vicksburg; Rosecrans retreated to Chattanooga; Thomas held Chickamauga. Sandra journeyed to the kitchen. Daniel journeyed to the bathroom.
